experiment: Scope-guarded optional insertions with whole-paper baseline rollback
baseline: Saved combined ID-safe numeric + grammar/unit output, 5.399738905338293% mean copied words>=6, 912/970 QA.
protection: Strict character insertions only; all original normalized words retained in order; exact numeric/unit/math, acronym, modal and negation signature unchanged. No possibility, probability, frequency or strength modifiers.3% whole-summary added-word cap.
acceptance: Every edit must lower absolute copied original words, absolute total copied words, six-gram hits and covered fraction. Report original fixed-denominator coverage to separate actual string breakage from padding.
meaning: Review every final visibly changed sentence/window with pinned27B teacher and instructions to check added certainty, scope, emphasis and meaning. No old prompt judgments reused. Exact before/after pairs deduplicated across arms.
evaluation: All original970 slots with frozen student, prompts/parser/sampling and paired seeds; exact-context cache only; no question/gold-based rewriting or selection. Full-source primary and punctuation-split audits on compute node.
limitation: Reused97-paper exploratory benchmark. Grammar rules and exact signatures do not prove equivalence. Inserting words is surface rewriting, not an independent conceptual paraphrase.
freeze_note: General dimensional-scope guard responds to inspected text, not QA gold. Frozen before revised compute run. No summary regeneration; all final contexts are exact prior evaluated outputs or baseline. Unknown QA context/pair causes failure, never imputation.
meaning_controls: 9 positive/adversarial controls, including added maybe/clearly, removed may/negation, changed scope and changed quantity. Controls never enter summary/QA/copy audit.
guard_revision: An insertion of temperature of must not capture a pressure/field/etc. in a shared-preposition coordination. Entire affected paper falls back to frozen baseline; retain every initial output/QA/meaning judgment.
